Audience: first-time Hawaii class three applicants, including minors on the graduated path, learning standard three-color signals, turns on red, lighted arrows, combination signals, flashing signals, lane control signals and pedestrian signals in plain English.

Prerequisites: the stop line and crosswalk markings from the previous section, which define the red-light stopping point.

Scope note: standard three-color signals, the red-light stopping point, right and left turns on red, yellow and green duties, lighted arrows, combination signals, flashing signals, lane control signals and pedestrian signals. Signs follow in the next section.

Recall emphasis: each indication's required action is practiced as a recall item, and indication identification feeds the dedicated recognition surface declared in part C.
